patterns.note: Content sections are primarily centered with a consistent max-width, creating clear reading areas, while hero and some image sections are full-bleed.
A sophisticated, large serif font is used for primary headings and venue names, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A muted, earthy color palette of dark charcoal, off-whites, and warm beige/terracotta is used for backgrounds and text, often derived directly from the photography.
The header starts transparent over the hero image, then transforms into an opaque white bar with a subtle bottom border as the user scrolls down the page.
Image galleries and venue listings are presented in clean, responsive grids, maintaining visual consistency across different content types.

technique_notes: A sticky header element is positioned at the top of the viewport. On scroll, a JavaScript listener (likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger) detects the scroll position and applies a class or inline styles to change its background color to solid white and add a subtle bottom border, ensuring text contrast over content. Sections below the hero likely fade or slide into view with a gentle delay as they enter the viewport, orchestrated by GSAP for a smooth reveal.

Full-bleed hero images are used with text overlaid, ensuring the image extends to the viewport edges. Content sections below use a fixed maximum width and horizontal centering to maintain readability and a structured appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, and smaller uppercase sans-serif for labels and calls to action.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with minimal rounding on buttons and image corners, maintaining a refined and crisp aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in hero and descriptive sections, creating a sense of calm and luxury. Grid layouts are more dense but still maintain clear separation.

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its sophisticated typography, pairing a grand serif with a modern sans-serif, and a muted, earthy color palette that feels deeply integrated with its high-quality photography. The overall effect is one of understated luxury and editorial elegance, rather than overt salesmanship.
